title: Graded quasi-isomorphisms contain identities and satisfy two-out-of-three
statement: For every commutative ring R, the class W of graded quasi-isomorphisms in the globally finite filtered module homotopy category contains identity maps and satisfies two-out-of-three. Thus it is closed under composition. The notation is that of [def-kun-finite-filtered-module-homotopy], with filtrations [def-sp-filtration], graded pieces [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], and ordinary quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tags 05S1 and 05RM, and Tag 05RG right MS2/MS3; extracted from the indicated steps of lem-kun-filtered-quasi-isomorphism-fractions.

proof.text: Restrict a filtration-preserving chain homotopy to every filtration step using the unique lift through its monic inclusion. Monic cancellation verifies the homotopy identity and compatibility with the inclusions of consecutive steps. Descend those homotopy components through the cokernel in every degree; evaluation preserves cokernels. This gives equality of graded maps after the ordinary derived localization, so each graded functor descends through the filtered homotopy quotient. The existential representative condition defining W is equivalent to being an isomorphism under every descended graded functor. Identities and two-out-of-three follow grade by grade from the corresponding facts for isomorphisms. Implemented completely in Lean; no new holes.
